About this space
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place with breathtaking bush views. Perfect for those who want to disconnect and take in nature. Nestled in a scenic valley with access to a dam and wildlife. Located in Juliusdale, approximately 40kms before Nyanga town.

The space
4-bedrooms, 3-bathrooms, full-kitchen and combined living and dining area. Bedroom 2 is up a flight of stairs so is not suitable for wheel-chair users or those with mobility issues. Ample outdoor space for barbequing, lounging and taking in views. Bathrooms have also recently been renovated!
